raw.details:
About CircuitX’26
CircuitX’26 is a 16-hour overnight hackathon organized by the IEEE Power and Energy Society (PES) and IEEE Circuits and Systems Society (CASS) Student Branch Chapters at BMS Institute of Technology and Management (BMSITM), Bengaluru, on 19-20 December 2026.

The hackathon has a total prize pool of ₹40,000, distributed equally across its two themes. There are no predefined problem statements. Teams choose a theme, find their own problem, and build an original prototype. A surprise awaits during the build.

Eligibility:

  • Open to students from all colleges and universities, all branches, and all academic years
  • Inter-college teams are allowed, and inter-specialization teams are allowed (students from different branches can form a team)
  • Team size: 2-4 members

Themes:

  • Theme 1 (CX01): Powering a Sustainable Future- Build energy, environment and resource solutions for a more sustainable and efficient future.
  • Theme 2 (CX02): Embedded Intelligence- Design sensor-driven embedded systems that monitor, decide and respond in the real world.
  • There are no problem statements
  • Teams must choose one theme and define their own problem within it
  • For details of the themes, visit here

Prize Pool & Distribution:

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹40,000
  • Per Theme: ₹20,000
  • 1st Prize: ₹12,000
  • 2nd Prize: ₹8,000

Hackathon Format & Process:

Round 1: PPT-Based Shortlisting (Online,Free)

  • Teams must submit their idea in the official PPT template provided by the organizing committee
  • PPT Template: CircuitX.pptx
  • Teams can save a copy of the PPT template that is provided
  • Maximum number of slides: 8
  • This round will be used to shortlist teams for the final hackathon
  • A total of 10 teams per theme (20 teams in all) will be shortlisted for the next round
  • Duration: 20th November to 30th November
  • The shortlist will be announced by 10th December

Round 2: 16-Hour Overnight Hackathon (Offline)

  • Shortlisted teams will participate in a 16-hour offline hackathon at the APJ Abdul Kalam Lab, BMSITM, on 19th-20th December
  • Teams are required to build and implement their solutions during the hackathon
  • Registration fee for Round 2 (shortlisted teams only, per team):
    • Non-IEEE teams: ₹1,000 per team
    • Teams with at least one IEEE CAS or PES member: ₹750 per team
  • Pre-built projects or previously developed solutions are strictly not allowed
  • A surprise awaits during the build
  • Teams must demonstrate their working prototype at the end

Rules:

  • Teams must have 2 to 4 members
  • Ideas must be submitted on the official PPT template
  • Only shortlisted teams can take part in the finale
  • All work must be completed during the hackathon duration
  • Use of pre-built or previously completed projects will result in disqualification
  • Solutions must strictly adhere to the chosen theme
  • Any form of plagiarism, misconduct, or rule violation will lead to disqualification
  • The decision of the judging panel and organizing committee shall be final and binding
